code:
# Write binary data
with open("file.bin", "wb") as binary_file:
    binary_file.write(b'\x00\x01\x02\x03')

# Read binary data
with open("file.bin", "rb") as binary_file:
    data = binary_file.read()
    print(data)
description: You can follow a four-byte value through a binary file.

steps.description: You open file.bin in binary write mode. The write receives four bytes with values zero through three.
The first with block closes before the next open. You reopen the same path in binary read mode.

steps.answer: It returns bytes because the file was opened with rb.
steps.question: Will read return a text string or bytes in this mode?

steps.description: You see a bytes representation containing the four hexadecimal escapes. The read recovers the same byte values that were written.

title: Writing and reading raw bytes
